modelSelector.capacityHelp: Browsers do not expose exact GPU VRAM. These are memory signals and WebGPU adapter limits reported by the browser.
modelSelector.modelExceedsBuffer: The selected model is larger than the reported maximum single WebGPU buffer. wllama may split model data internally, but older or lower-memory GPUs can fail to load or fall back.
modelSelector.settingsHelp: Advanced settings for model loading and inference. Adjust these only if you understand the implications.
modelSelector.gpuLayersHint: -1 for GPU Layers (use all available GPU layers)
modelSelector.highSettingsWarning: Large and Extra Large settings may significantly slow down your browser and consume substantial memory. Use them only if your device has sufficient resources.
modelSelector.modelSubtitle: Local GGUF file and runtime details.
modelSelector.chooseHelp: Choose a local GGUF model file to load with wllama.
modelSelector.selectFilesHint: Select one `.gguf` file, or multiple `.gguf` shard files for a split model.

providerSetup.modelsAvailable_one: {{count}} model available on the server. Pick one or type a name.
providerSetup.modelsAvailable_other: {{count}} models available on the server. Pick one or type a name.
providerSetup.runTestHint: Run Test connection to list the models the server offers.
providerSetup.anthropicBaseUrlHelp: Requests go straight from the browser to the API.
providerSetup.baseUrlHelp: Must end with the API version segment, e.g. …/v1. Local servers must allow this origin (CORS).
providerSetup.apiKeyHelpLocal: Optional: only if your server expects a bearer token. Stored only inside the encrypted database.
providerSetup.apiKeyHelp: Stored only inside the encrypted database.
providerSetup.presentCertificate: Present my client certificate to this endpoint
providerSetup.certificateHelp: A browser cannot read a .pfx file or attach it to a request, so the certificate has to live in your system certificate store. On Windows, double-click the .pfx, choose Current User, enter its password and keep the Personal store; then restart the browser. With this switch on, requests to the endpoint include credentials so the browser offers that certificate.
providerSetup.certificateCorsHelp: The server must answer CORS with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true and an explicit Access-Control-Allow-Origin (not *).
providerSetup.noLocalEndpoints: No local endpoints yet. Add one to chat with Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or any other OpenAI-compatible server.
providerSetup.browserModeHelp: Runs a GGUF model file inside this browser tab with wllama. No data leaves this device.
providerSetup.endpointModeHelp: Connects to an OpenAI-compatible server on your machine or network, such as Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM.
providerSetup.chatUsesLocalEndpoint: Chat currently uses the local endpoint "{{label}}".
providerSetup.chatUsesCloudProfile: Chat currently uses the cloud profile "{{label}}".
providerSetup.localEndpointsDescription: Profiles and API keys are stored in the encrypted database and sent only to the server you configure.
providerSetup.cloudProvidersDescription: Profiles and API keys are stored in the encrypted database and sent only to the provider you configure.

groupDescription.create: Add new rows. Ask by default.

groupDescription.delete: Remove rows. Ask by default and disabled until you enable them.
groupDescription.mixed: Statements that both read and write. Ask by default.

toolsTab.pastePackPrompt: Paste a pack JSON document or choose a file.
toolsTab.title: Tools
toolsTab.subtitle: Choose which tools the assistant may call and when it has to ask first.
toolsTab.bypassOnHelp: Every enabled tool runs without asking for this session. Tools set to Deny still never run.
toolsTab.bypassOffHelp: Tools set to Ask pause the chat until you allow them.
toolsTab.toolCallLimitHelp: Rounds of tool calls the assistant may run for one question ({{min}}–{{max}}). A round can call several tools at once. After the last round it answers from what it found.
toolsTab.toolPacksHelp: Declarative JSON packs add SQL-backed tools. Each tool's SQL is checked against its declared read/write class before it can be used.
toolsTab.bypassBody: The assistant will run every enabled create, update and delete tool without asking first, for this browser session. Tools set to Deny are still blocked. You can turn this off at any time.
toolsTab.resetBody: Every tool returns to its default: reads allowed, creates and updates ask, deletes ask and are disabled. Session grants and the bypass switch are cleared. Imported packs are kept.
